FIELDS.NAME: Precision Countertop Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Precision Countertop Solutions, we specialize in the installation of a wide range of countertop and surface materials, including granite, quartz, marble, and laminate. Our operations encompass every phase of the project, from initial consultation and design to careful measurement, fabrication, and final installation. We pride ourselves on maintaining strict adherence to local building codes and fire safety regulations, as these are fundamental to ensuring the safety and satisfaction of our clients. 

All our installers are highly trained and have a minimum of three years of experience, ensuring accuracy and quality in every installation. We conduct thorough risk assessments before commencing any project, identifying potential hazards to mitigate risks effectively. Clear contracts specifying the scope, payment terms, and timelines are established for each job to prevent misunderstandings and disputes.

To enhance our service, we maintain only the highest standards of material handling and storage procedures, reducing the chances of damage during transit and installation. This commitment to quality and safety is reflected in our clean claims history, reinforcing our reputation as a reliable choice for countertop installation services.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, while performing an installation at a residential property, a team member accidentally dropped a granite slab, resulting in a material loss valued at $1,000. The incident was reported immediately, and the loss was resolved through our inventory adjustment protocols without any impact on client satisfaction. Status: Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8 AM - 5 PM; Saturday: 9 AM - 3 PM; Closed Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II, Grade 1, 5-Year Burglary Protection Label
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Perimeter fencing and on-site watchpersons for enhanced security during installation projects.
